status: retrospective follow-up; PR15 fits and data already inspected; targets fixed before this feasibility search
model_class: all stationary qubit CPTP gate sets over Gi,Gx,Gy, with a shared arbitrary physical preparation and binary POVM; no unital, Pauli, Lindblad or near-ideal restriction
observations: all 4657 GST and all 2004 RB rows in PR15's pinned 2015-03-30 sources; no training subset
primary_observable: q = (1 + mu_RB - mu_GST)/2, where mu_F is the shot-denominator-weighted mean probability over every recorded circuit in family F. Operationally choose either family with probability 1/2, sample its word with exposure weights, and count plus for RB or minus for GST.
secondary_observable: mu_RB itself: a prediction from GST-only constraints, directly constrained when RB is added
scope: prediction of a specified mixture of recorded circuit contexts, not an unmeasured primitive sequence or untouched validation

confidence.cell_construction: two-sided Clopper-Pearson endpoints rounded outward and certified by exact integer binomial tails
confidence.groups: for each source: overall exposure-weighted mean and length bins 0-16,17-64,65-256,257-1024,1025-8198
confidence.group_construction: two-sided Hoeffding; each group gets alpha .025/12; outward radius is certified by rational arithmetic
confidence.removal: drop all constraints involving the removed source, retaining the original budgets, endpoints and physical model class
confidence.sampling: independent Bernoulli shots with a fixed probability per circuit. Under unrestricted within-row dependence this confidence construction is not valid.

joint_bound: q <= (1 + upper_mean_RB - lower_mean_GST)/2; applies to the entire declared physical model class, without optimization
feasibility_search: seek explicit physically parameterized gate sets satisfying every retained cell and group constraint but exceeding the joint upper bound; general CPTP constrained optimization, with successful witnesses independently verified
numerics: require separation and constraint margins above 2e-8; independently propagate Kraus operators; local failures are only search failures
success: GST-only witness crossing the joint bound; ideally also RB-only witness crossing the same bound; a joint-compatible model ensures nonempty joint set
novelty: separate question; this result would establish explicit full-model constraint-set gain, not by itself a new physical mechanism or major advance
